caption: The drawing depicts a single large ceramic jug with a rounded body that narrows toward the top, ending in a short, cylindrical neck and small mouth. The jug is rendered in shades of gray and light brown, and there are subtle variations in tone indicating shading and the contour of the jug’s surface. On the upper front of the jug, black text reads “J. BROWN & BROS. HUNTINGTON. L. I.” Below the text and slightly to the left is a stylized blue flower or leaf design painted on the jug. The background is a neutral off-white and the jug is the only object present in the composition.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
